title: Programmable Calculator Draft
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: PROGRAMMABLE CALCULATOR DRAFT
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Increasing lines; common pointer base 22204; exact end marker/EOF; byte-identical left/right payload
versions.unavailableReason: The source refers to extensions, external cassette data, machine code, or functions unavailable in the stock player. Source/development material; no self-contained stock Level II player is supplied.
versions.startupSource:
5 '***** GAVE UP JULY 1979 BECAUSE OF DIFFICULTIES IN SIMMULATION *****
1000 REM     PROGRAMMER
1010 '
1020 REM     DEFINE CONSTANTS
1030     PI = 3.14159
1040     E  = 2.7179766
1050 '
1060 REM     DEFINE NEW FUCTIONS
1070     DEF FNS(X) = ATN( X/ SQR( -X * X +1 ) ):'  ARC-SINE
1080     DEF FNC(X) = - FNS( X ) + PI/2         :'  ARC-COSINE
1090     DEF FNL(X) = E [ X                     :'  ANTI-LOG
1100     DEF FNR(X) = X / PI *180               :'  RAD TO DEG
